bindingInstructions.sourceGates: {path,sha256} of a Lead-accepted receipt containing candidate, tree, sourceAccepted:true, currentGatesAccepted:true. The t206 accepted result is available; this null is an unbound transferred receipt, not a missing source review.
bindingInstructions.hostedHandoff: {path,sha256} containing task:t199,candidate,tree,authorized:true,runID as string,scenarios exactly as above. A general release authority is not invented as an actual runtime runID.
bindingInstructions.releaseSourceCommit: Actual full immutable S tag commit after source/metadata integration; preserve separate approved candidate source identity.
bindingInstructions.artifactRuntimeReceipt: Both verification receipts must bind actual runtimeSHA256, extensionSHA256, updaterPublicKey, candidate, candidateTree, sourceFilesVerified:true and passed:true. runtimeSHA256 is SHA-256 of json.dumps({internal/piruntime/assets/NAME: embedded asset SHA256 for the six shipped assets},sort_keys=True). Expected source aggregate is 3652e1b07378b9d6846733fbd9bef04ac1168ae4e68281475d30af9a45769329; actual package evidence remains unbound. Each native phase also captures ready.json, all installed patch-after hashes and pending queue identity.
bindingInstructions.Q: version,sourceCommit,archiveSHA256,mainSHA256,bundleInventorySHA256,webSHA256,producerRunID,transferArtifactID,verificationReceipt:{path,sha256}; receipt additionally privateQA:true. Q is an Actions artifact with no release asset allocation.
bindingInstructions.packagePlanSHA256: Hash exact two-stage production plan bytes before path normalization. Plan.Target darwin-arm64; kind released-candidate-plus-private-QA; sourceSHA equals S commit; PublicKey exact compiled public key; Feed http://127.0.0.1:PORT; Stages contain official S then private Q with Archive/Manifest/Web/Source/Version/mainName/binarySHA256/official. Relative paths resolve beside plan.json.
bindingInstructions.hashAlgorithms: All file hashes SHA-256. webSHA256 hashes json.dumps(relative-name-to-file-SHA256,sort_keys=True). bundleInventorySHA256 uses the unchanged host_proof.bundle_inventory. Preserve all raw verification sources for independent review. Receipt hashes bind supplied evidence; they are not remote attestation.
